meaning:
Ἀβιά (Heb. אֲבִיָּה, אֲבִיָּהוּ), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀβίας, -α),
Abia, Abijah.
1. Son of Rehoboam (3Ki.14:1): Mat.1:7.
2. A priest of the line of Eleazar (1Ch.24:3, 10): Luk.1:5.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.
